desktop-settings.microphone.developer_comment: Label of dropdown to select active microphone

desktop-settings.camera.developer_comment: Label of dropdown to select active camera

desktop-settings.loading.developer_comment: Placeholder item in dropdown while data is being fetched

desktop-settings.no-devices.developer_comment: Appears in dropdown to select camera or microphone if none were found

desktop-settings.error.developer_comment: Appears in dropdown to select camera or microphone if there was an error

desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-w.string: Use graphics acceleration when available (requires restart)
desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-w.developer_comment: Desktop settings option to toggle hardware acceleration/graphics acceleration

desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration.developer_comment: Desktop settings option to toggle hardware acceleration/graphics acceleration

desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-d.string: Disabling graphics acceleration significantly reduces performance. Some projects can run over 100x slower as all rendering will be done by your CPU. This should only be done as a last resort if graphics acceleration is causing crashes.
desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-d.developer_comment: Warning that appears in desktop settings when hardware acceleration/graphics acceleration is disabled

desktop-settings.background-throttling.developer_comment: Desktop settings option to disable background window throttling

desktop-settings.background-throttling-d.string: Allowing hidden windows to remain active will result in higher CPU usage and lower battery life.
desktop-settings.background-throttling-d.developer_comment: Warning that appears in desktop settings when background throttling is disabled

desktop-settings.bypass-cors.string: Allow extensions to access any website
desktop-settings.bypass-cors.developer_comment: Desktop settings option to let extensions bypass normal security stuff

desktop-settings.bypass-cors-enabled.string: This disables several web security features designed to protect you. Malicious projects or extensions will be able to access any website or device on your network.
desktop-settings.bypass-cors-enabled.developer_comment: Warning that appears in desktop settings when bypass CORS is enabled

desktop-settings.spellchecker.developer_comment: Option in desktop settings to disable spell checking

desktop-settings.exit-fullscreen-on-esca.string: Exit F11 fullscreen mode (not the fullscreen button in the editor) when pressing escape
desktop-settings.exit-fullscreen-on-esca.developer_comment: Refering to when an entire window is in fullscreen by pressing F11 or the maximize button on macOS, not the fullscreen mode you get by pressing the fullscreen button in the editor.

desktop-settings.render-gpu-mode.developer_comment: Option in desktop settings to control how the renderer detects sprite collisions. 'Automatic' picks the fastest method per query.

desktop-settings.render-gpu-mode-automat.developer_comment: Renderer automatically picks GPU or CPU for collision detection.

desktop-settings.render-gpu-mode-force-g.developer_comment: Force the GPU path for collision detection.

desktop-settings.render-gpu-mode-force-c.string: Prefer CPU (more stable on old graphics cards)
desktop-settings.render-gpu-mode-force-c.developer_comment: Force the CPU path for collision detection.

desktop-settings.render-resolution-cap.developer_comment: Option in desktop settings to cap the resolution the stage is rendered at, to improve performance on low-end devices. 'Off' uses the display's full resolution.

desktop-settings.render-resolution-cap-o.developer_comment: Do not cap the stage rendering resolution.

desktop-settings.rich-presence.developer_comment: Option to enable Discord Rich Presence support, which shows the name of the project someone is editing on their Discord profile. For compliance with Scratch policies don't use the word "Discord" in the translation.

desktop-settings.rich-presence-unavailab.string: Rich Presence is not available in this version of the app
desktop-settings.rich-presence-unavailab.developer_comment: Appears in desktop settings after a disabled checkbox (grayed out and unchangeable) if Discord Rich Presence can't be enabled.

desktop-settings.more-information.developer_comment: Appears in desktop settings after options as a link to a webpage with more information about the option.

desktop-settings.open-user-data.developer_comment: Button in desktop settings to open the user data folder

migrate.title.developer_comment: Title of window that does various things to finish an update

migrate.description.string: This is a one-time process that may take a few moments.
migrate.description.developer_comment: More information about process to finish an update

migrate.error.string: There was an error finishing this update. Some data may not have transferred correctly. Send a screenshot of this window to:
migrate.error.developer_comment: Appears when there was an error finishing an update. Followed by an email.

migrate.timed-out.string: This process is taking an unusually long time. If no progress is being made, please send a screenshot of this window to:
migrate.timed-out.developer_comment: Appears when finishing an update is taking longer than it usually does. There are some other pieces of text on the screen that may indicate progress is still being made, albiet slowly. Followed by an email.

migrate.renderer-gone.string: Updating process crashed (reason: {reason}, code: {code}). Some data may not have transferred correctly. Please send a screenshot of this window to:
migrate.renderer-gone.developer_comment: Appears when an important process crashes while finishing an update.

migrate.continue-anyways.developer_comment: Appears when there was an error finishing an update. This button ignores the error and continues anyways.

migrate.continue-anyways-afterword.string: If any of your data is missing, please contact us at {email}.
migrate.continue-anyways-afterword.developer_comment: Appears after there was an error finishing an update and someone clicks the Continue Anyways button to ignore the error.

migrate.exit.developer_comment: Appears when there was an error finishing an update. This button closes the app and does not continue.

migrate.preparing.developer_comment: Status message that appears while finishing an update.

migrate.transfer-editor.developer_comment: Status message that appears while finishing an update.

migrate.transfer-packager.developer_comment: Status message that appears while finishing an update.

migrate.finalizing.developer_comment: Status message that appears while finishing an update.

migrate.delete-legacy.developer_comment: Status message that appears while finishing an update. Old data refers to data stored by old versions of the app that is now redundant after updates.

downgrade-warning.title.developer_comment: Appears when someone installs the latest version of the dekstop app, runs it, then installs and runs an older version.

downgrade-warning.message.string:
You are using an older version of {APP_NAME} after using a later version. Please exit and download the latest version from {website}.

If you continue, it is VERY LIKELY that you will PERMANENTLY lose all of your settings and backpack. We WILL NOT be able to recover your data.

(Debug info: {debugInfo})
downgrade-warning.message.developer_comment: Appears when someone installs the latest version of the dekstop app, runs it, then installs and runs an older version. {APP_NAME} becomes 'TurboWarp Desktop'. {website} becomes a URL like 'desktop.turbowarp.org'. {debugInfo} becomes some internal stuff that shouldn't matter. This is supposed to be a very scary warning.

downgrade-warning.exit.developer_comment: Appears when someone installs the latest version of the dekstop app, runs it, then installs and runs an older version. This button exits the app and opens the website for someone to download the latest version.

downgrade-warning.continue-anyways.developer_comment: Appears when someone installs the latest version of the dekstop app, runs it, then installs and runs an older version. This button ignores the warning and will just continue anyways, possibly deleting user data, and thus is very dangerous.

update.normal-title.developer_comment: Header of update available window for normal update

update.security-title.developer_comment: Header of update available window for security updates

update.normal-description.developer_comment: Description of update available window for normal update. {appNameVersion} will be replaced with something like 'TurboWarp Desktop v1.2.3'.

update.security-description.string: {appNameVersion} is now available. This release contains security fixes. Updating is highly recommended.
update.security-description.developer_comment: Description of update available window for security update. {appNameVersion} will be replaced with something like 'TurboWarp Desktop v1.2.3'.

update.loading.developer_comment: Appears in update available window while the changelog is still loading

update.download-button.developer_comment: Appears in update available window. Button to download the update.

update.ignore-button.developer_comment: Appears in update available window. Button to ignore this update temporarily.

update.ignore-version-toggle.developer_comment: Appears in update available window. Label of the switch that ignores updates of the current version.

update.ignore-version-toggle-note.string: You won't be reminded about this version again. Newer versions will still notify you.
update.ignore-version-toggle-note.developer_comment: Appears in update available window. Explanation shown when the ignore switch is on.

update.ignore-version-toggle-note-off.string: You will be reminded about this version when the app starts.
update.ignore-version-toggle-note-off.developer_comment: Appears in update available window. Explanation shown when the ignore switch is off.

update.not-available.developer_comment: Appears in update available window when, for some reason, no detailed release notes are available.

update.changelog-error.developer_comment: Appears in update available window when changelog could not be loaded, for example because the website is down.

update.choose-source.developer_comment: Label above the list of download sources in the update available window

update.no-sources.string: No download source is available for this release.
update.no-sources.developer_comment: Appears in update available window when the release has no matching installer assets

update.no-changelog.string: No changelog was provided for this release.
update.no-changelog.developer_comment: Appears in update available window when the GitHub release body is empty

update.background-download.developer_comment: Appears in update available window. Button to download the update in the background and close the window.

update.releases-page.developer_comment: Appears in update available window and desktop settings. Button to open the GitHub releases page in the browser.

update.idle.developer_comment: Idle status text under the progress bar in the update available window

update.downloading.developer_comment: Appears in update available window while the installer is being downloaded

update.downloading-progress.developer_comment: Progress of the update download. {percent}, {received} and {total} will be replaced with numbers.

update.downloading-progress-detail.developer_comment: Progress of the update download once the transfer speed is known. {percent}, {received}, {total} and {speed} will be replaced with numbers, {remaining} with a duration such as 'about 2 minutes'.

update.remaining-soon.developer_comment: Estimated download time left, shown when it is under 5 seconds.

update.remaining-seconds.developer_comment: Estimated download time left. {seconds} will be replaced with a number under 60.

update.remaining-minutes.developer_comment: Estimated download time left. {minutes} will be replaced with a number under 60.

update.remaining-hours.developer_comment: Estimated download time left when it is over an hour. {minutes} will be replaced with a number of hours.

update.download-retry.string: {mirror} did not respond. Switching to {next} ({attempt} of {total})...
update.download-retry.developer_comment: Shown while the update download automatically moves from a failed download mirror to the next one. {mirror} and {next} will be replaced with mirror names, {attempt} and {total} with numbers.

update.download-failed.string: Download failed. Every mirror failed too. Check your network connection, then try again or use a custom download source.
update.download-failed.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window when the download failed on the selected mirror and on every fallback mirror.

update.download-complete-body.string: Download complete. The installer is ready: {fileName}
update.download-complete-body.developer_comment: Appears in desktop settings and the update available window after the installer finished downloading. {fileName} will be replaced with the file name.

update.download-complete-title.developer_comment: Title of the system notification shown after the installer finished downloading

update.download-failed-body.developer_comment: Appears in desktop settings and the update available window when the download failed. {error} will be replaced with the error message.

update.download-failed-title.developer_comment: Title of the system notification shown when the download failed

update.choose-proxy.developer_comment: Label above the list of download mirrors in the update available window

update.custom-source.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window. Label above the text box for a custom download source.

update.custom-source-note.string: Optional. Enter a mirror address such as https://mirror.example.com/gh/ to download from somewhere other than GitHub. Leave empty to use the mirror selected above.
update.custom-source-note.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window. Explanation below the custom download source text box.

update.cancel-download-button.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window while an update is downloading. Button to cancel the download and delete the partial file.

update.download-canceled.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window after the user cancels a download.

update.delete-installer-button.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window once the installer has been downloaded. Button to delete the downloaded installer file.

update.delete-complete.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window after the user deletes the downloaded installer.

update.delete-failed.string: Could not delete the file. It might be in use by another program.
update.delete-failed.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window when deleting the downloaded installer fails.

update.installer-location.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window. Tells the user where the installer file is saved. {directory} will be replaced with the path of the directory.

update.reveal-installer-button.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window once the installer has been downloaded. Button to open the file manager and select the downloaded installer.

update.install-button.developer_comment: Appears in update available window. Button to run the downloaded installer and quit the app.

update.menu-bar-available.developer_comment: Appears in the editor's menu bar when a new version is available. {version} will be replaced with the version number, for example '1.2.3'.

update.current-version.developer_comment: Shows the version the user is currently running in the update available window. {version} will be replaced with something like '1.2.3'.

update.latest-version.developer_comment: Shows the version that is available to download in the update available window. {version} will be replaced with something like '1.2.3'.

update.install-need-download.string: Download the update before installing it.
update.install-need-download.developer_comment: Appears in update available window when the user clicks Update Now but nothing has been downloaded yet

update.auto-source.developer_comment: Label above the automatically selected update package in the update available window. The package matching the user's operating system and CPU architecture is picked automatically.

update.auto-source-note.developer_comment: Appears under the automatically selected update package, explaining why it was picked. {platform} and {arch} will be replaced with the detected operating system and CPU architecture.

update.no-compatible-source.string: No update package matches this system ({platform} · {arch}). Open GitHub Releases to download one manually.
update.no-compatible-source.developer_comment: Appears in update available window when no asset of the release matches the user's operating system and CPU architecture. {platform} and {arch} will be replaced with the detected operating system and CPU architecture.

update.install-ready-title.developer_comment: Title of the in-app dialog asking whether to install the update right after the installer finished downloading.

update.install-ready-message.string: {appNameVersion} is ready to install. The app will close while the installer runs.
update.install-ready-message.developer_comment: Body of the in-app dialog asking whether to install the update. {appNameVersion} will be replaced with something like 'CYSOEditor v1.2.3'.

update.install-later-button.developer_comment: Button in the in-app dialog that dismisses the install prompt without installing, so the user can install from the update window later.

update.install-missing.string: The installer is missing. Download the update again.
update.install-missing.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window when the user clicks Update Now but the downloaded installer no longer exists on disk.

update.install-invalid.string: The installer file is incomplete or corrupted. Download the update again.
update.install-invalid.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window when the user clicks Update Now but the installer on disk is incomplete, has the wrong size, or does not look like a valid installer.

update.already-downloaded.string: The installer is already downloaded. Install it when you are ready.
update.already-downloaded.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window when the user clicks Download Update but the installer is already on disk, so nothing was downloaded again.

update.install-done.string: The installer has been started. The app will close now.
update.install-done.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window right after the user starts the installer from that window.

update.cleanup-failed.developer_comment: Appears in the update available window when old installer files could not be deleted from disk.

desktop-settings.releases-page.developer_comment: Button in desktop settings to open the GitHub releases page

desktop-settings.update-available-downlo.developer_comment: Button in desktop settings that opens the update available window after a check found a new version

desktop-settings.update-check-no-update.string: You are running the latest version ({version}).
desktop-settings.update-check-no-update.developer_comment: Result of checking for updates in desktop settings when the app is already up to date

desktop-settings.update-check-available.developer_comment: Result of checking for updates in desktop settings when a newer version exists. {version} and {currentVersion} will be replaced with version numbers.

desktop-settings.update-check-error.developer_comment: Appears in desktop settings when checking for updates failed. {error} will be replaced with the error message.

desktop-settings.checking-updates.developer_comment: Status shown in desktop settings while checking for updates

desktop-settings.check-updates.developer_comment: Button in desktop settings to check for updates manually

files.svg.developer_comment: Appears in file saving dialog when exporting a vector costume

files.png.developer_comment: Appears in file saving dialog when exporting a bitmap costume

files.wav.developer_comment: Appears in file saving dialog when exporting a sound

files.sprite3.developer_comment: Appears in file saving dialog when exporting a sprite

files.txt.developer_comment: Appears in file saving dialog when exporting a list

files.webm.developer_comment: Appears in file saving dialog when exporting a video with an addon

files.html.developer_comment: Appears in file saving dialog when saving some types of packaged projects

files.zip.developer_comment: Appears in file saving dialog when saving some types of packaged projects

security-prompt.title.developer_comment: Title of extension security prompt window

security-prompt.allow.developer_comment: Title of extension security prompt window. This button allows the permission.

security-prompt.deny.developer_comment: Title of extension security prompt window. This button denies the permission.

security-prompt.read-clipboard1.string: The project wants to read data from your clipboard.
security-prompt.read-clipboard1.developer_comment: Part of the extension security prompt window

security-prompt.read-clipboard2.string: If your clipboard contains things like passwords, the project may be able to share those with other users or servers.
security-prompt.read-clipboard2.developer_comment: Part of the extension security prompt window

security-prompt.read-clipboard3.string: Clipboard access may not work on some systems. If allowed, further clipboard reads will be automatically allowed.
security-prompt.read-clipboard3.developer_comment: Part of the extension security prompt window

security-prompt.notifications1.string: The project wants to display notifications.
security-prompt.notifications1.developer_comment: Part of the extension security prompt window

security-prompt.notifications2.string: If allowed, you may be prompted to enable notifications by your operating system, and further notifications will be automatically allowed.
security-prompt.notifications2.developer_comment: Part of the extension security prompt window

unsafe-path.title.developer_comment: Title of alert that appears when someone tries to save project in an 'unsafe' place where their work would end up being deleted.

unsafe-path.details.string: The file you selected ({file}) is in a folder used internally by {APP_NAME}. It is not safe to save projects here as they can be deleted when the app updates. You must choose a different folder.
unsafe-path.details.developer_comment: Message of alert that appears when someone tries to save project in a folder used internally by the app. {file} is replaced with the path and {APP_NAME} with the name of the app.

cyso.command-confirm.title.developer_comment: Title of dialog that asks the user to confirm running a potentially dangerous command from an extension.

cyso.command-confirm.message.string: This command may affect your system's software environment.
cyso.command-confirm.message.developer_comment: Message of the command execution confirmation dialog.

cyso.command-confirm.details.string:
Command: {command}

Are you sure you want to continue?
cyso.command-confirm.details.developer_comment: Details of the command execution confirmation dialog. {command} is replaced with the command string.

cyso.command-confirm.cancel.developer_comment: Button that cancels the command execution confirmation dialog.

cyso.command-confirm.run.developer_comment: Button that continues running the command in the confirmation dialog.

cyso.command-blocked.string: Security restriction: the command is blocked because it could harm your system.
cyso.command-blocked.developer_comment: Error returned to an extension when its command was blocked by the security filter.

cyso.command-cancelled.developer_comment: Error returned to an extension when the user cancelled the command confirmation dialog.

rich-presence.untitled.developer_comment: Appears in Discord rich presence when the current project doesn't have a name.

file-access.window-title.developer_comment: Title of window that appears when user tries to drag & drop a file that the app can't access because of a security sandbox.

file-access.flatpak.string: The Flatpak sandbox may be preventing {APP_NAME} from accessing files that you tried to drag and drop:
file-access.flatpak.developer_comment: Part of window that appears when user tries to drag & drop a file that the app can't access. Followed by list of paths. Leave 'Flatpak' in English.

file-access.how-to-fix.string: Use the file pickers in the app instead of drag and drop, or run the following command in a terminal and restart the app to grant access:
file-access.how-to-fix.developer_comment: Part of window that appears when user tries to drag & drop a file that the app can't access. Followed by a terminal command.

data-preview.title.developer_comment: Title of windows when a project opens a data: URL. data: is a technical term, you probably don't need to translate it.

extension-documentation.title.developer_comment: Title of in-app window for viewing extension documentation.
